file_space_definition: sum of file lengths; filesystem allocation and directory metadata excluded
durability: FastK: per-month synced files+manifest, Windows directory sync best-effort; SQLite: WAL synchronous FULL bulk transaction+checkpoint; DuckDB: bulk transaction+checkpoint; Parquet/Arrow: fsynced files, POSIX directory sync. These are not equivalent crash guarantees.
threads: DuckDB and file readers use one thread; FastK bridge is synchronous
metrics: query time includes full Python materialization; validation outside timer; RSS includes worker and FastK subprocesses
